title: Ultrawave Minimal RAM Record/Play Core (No Custom GUI)
description: Implement the minimal shared-RAM Record/Play workflow: MIDI-triggered fixed-length recording from input into R1-R4 and matching-channel one-shot playback. Scope excludes custom GUI and advanced DSP.

title: US-001: Shared RAM Buffer Registry
description:
As a plugin instance, I want access to a global shared buffer registry (`R1-R4`) so that Record and Play plugins can exchange audio by channel.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Global registry exposes exactly 4 addressable buffers (`R1-R4`).
- [ ] Record and Play instances can read/write the same underlying channel buffer.
- [ ] Concurrent access is thread-safe and real-time safe (no blocking in audio thread).
- [ ] Unit tests verify write/read correctness across instances for each channel.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes.
- [ ] `cargo test` passes.
- [ ] `cargo build --release` passes.

title: US-002: MIDI-Triggered Fixed-Length Recording
description:
As a user, I want `Record` to start capture on MIDI trigger and stop automatically at knob-defined length so that recording is predictable.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `Note On` triggers recording start.
- [ ] Recording duration is fixed by Record `LEN` parameter at trigger time.
- [ ] Recording source is plugin audio input.
- [ ] Recording auto-stops exactly at configured duration.
- [ ] Trigger behavior while already recording is explicitly implemented and tested.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes.
- [ ] `cargo test` passes.
- [ ] `cargo build --release` passes.

title: US-003: Channel Assignment and Routing
description:
As a user, I want each Record/Play instance assigned to one RAM channel (`R1-R4`) so that playback uses the matching recorded content.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Record instance writes only to its configured RAM channel.
- [ ] Play instance reads only from its configured RAM channel.
- [ ] Cross-channel isolation is verified (`R2` data never appears in `R1` playback).
- [ ] Channel selection parameters are host-automatable and stable.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes.
- [ ] `cargo test` passes.
- [ ] `cargo build --release` passes.

title: US-004: MIDI-Triggered One-Shot Playback (Minimal)
description:
As a user, I want Play to trigger one-shot mono playback at fixed pitch so I can immediately hear captured audio.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `Note On` triggers playback.
- [ ] Playback is mono one-shot from channel buffer start to end.
- [ ] No envelope/filter/pitch modulation beyond fixed baseline behavior.
- [ ] Empty-buffer trigger behavior is deterministic and non-crashing (silence/no-op).
- [ ] Tests cover trigger and end-of-buffer behavior.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes.
- [ ] `cargo test` passes.
- [ ] `cargo build --release` passes.

title: US-005: Non-Persistent RAM Lifecycle
description:
As a user, I expect RAM buffers to be temporary so that state resets after plugin/host reload in this milestone.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Buffer contents are not serialized into plugin state/presets.
- [ ] Host/project reload starts with empty RAM buffers.
- [ ] Behavior is documented in README/notes for this milestone.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes.
- [ ] `cargo test` passes.
- [ ] `cargo build --release` passes.
